entities.name: Query protein (250 aa)
observations: Exact sequence match to reviewed UniProt Q12NS9 from Shewanella denitrificans.
Sequence length is 250 aa; predicted molecular mass 26.65 kDa and theoretical pI 4.91.
Contains Pfam His_biosynth domain PF00977.28 spanning residues 1–238.
Reference active-site annotations identify residue 7 as a proton acceptor and residue 129 as a proton donor.
The protein is annotated as cytoplasmic and participates in L-histidine biosynthesis; homolog annotations also link it to L-tryptophan biosynthesis.
No cofactor requirement was reported in the retrieved annotation.

entities.name: HisA isomerase reaction
observations: Converts 1-(5-phospho-beta-D-ribosyl)-5-[(5-phospho-beta-D-ribosylamino)methylideneamino]imidazole-4-carboxamide to the corresponding phosphoribulosyl-imino intermediate in histidine biosynthesis.

entities.name: L-histidine biosynthesis
observations: The enzyme catalyzes step 4 of 9 in the pathway from phosphoribosyl pyrophosphate to L-histidine.

entities.name: L-tryptophan biosynthesis
observations: The retrieved UniProt homolog annotations associate this enzyme with the L-tryptophan biosynthetic process, likely reflecting the shared role of the HisA/HisF-type isomerase family in aromatic amino-acid biosynthesis.
